description: Get a download URL for a stored document. Default: time-limited (expires_in seconds, default 3600, max 86400) — to LOOK at what you produced before sending it on. permanent=true: a link that stays valid as long as the document exists (not guessable, downloads counted) — use THIS for links you put into mails or chats for other people (e.g. a Lab-Order Excel for the lab). Required: document_id.

permanent.description: true = link valid as long as the document exists, for sharing with others

name: get_document_link
